hero.title: Sri Lanka’s first IEEE Student Branch.
hero.text: Seven chapters and affinity groups, one community of young engineers — inspiring each other to achieve, and leading our community to greater heights through the worldwide IEEE network.

announcement.text: Celebrating 25 years of IEEE at Peradeniya · 2001 – 2026

statement: We inspire future engineers to achieve, and lead our community to greater heights — by giving every student a platform to reach out to the world and try everything, because we believe in the impact engineers can make to build a better tomorrow for everyone.

IEEE student branch established in Sri Lanka
Of engineers building a better tomorrow

vision: To be the go-to place for professionals and students in the engineering, science and technology community of the University of Peradeniya.
mission: To establish ourselves as a platform for collaboration, innovation and professional development — creating and bridging the gap to the opportunities IEEE offers, within the university and beyond, through the strength of the worldwide IEEE network.

timeline.title: The first IEEE student branch in Sri Lanka
timeline.body: Founded on 19 July 2001 at the Faculty of Engineering with the help of IEEE senior members and dedicated student members.

timeline.title: Winner — IEEE Region 10 website contest
timeline.body: The branch’s first website, launched by the 2010 committee headed by Mr. B.L.D.S. Balasooriya under the guidance of Prof. Lilantha Samaranayake and Dr. A. Atputharaja, won the R10 contest.

timeline.title: Sri Lanka’s first IEEE MTT-S student chapter
timeline.body: The Microwave Theory and Technology Society chapter begins — later funding a 4.6 m parabolic antenna to serve as a radio telescope.

timeline.title: Sat Cap antenna workshop
timeline.body: MTT-S runs its first antenna workshop with Eng. Tharindu Dayarathne, creator of Raavana-1 — Sri Lanka’s first CubeSat.

timeline.title: Bittopia — the coding arcade
timeline.body: Xtreme.Pera-23 brings IEEEXtreme to campus: teams compete through the night at the Faculty of Engineering, alongside the global contest.

timeline.title: Predicta 1.0 & CodeVortex
timeline.body: A national AI prediction challenge on Kaggle joins the flagship line-up, and Pera.Xtreme CodeVortex trains teams for IEEEXtreme 18.0.

timeline.title: IEEE Computer Society chapter goes live
timeline.body: The newest member of the #ieeepdn family opens doors to tech innovation — WIE, ComSoc and PES keep a packed calendar of talks, visits and outreach.

timeline.title: Twenty-five years
timeline.body: LEVEL UP draws 350+ participants, seven chapters and affinity groups share one branch — and a brand-new home on the web, kept fresh by every chapter’s own webmaster.

cta.title: Build the branch with us.
cta.text: Volunteer calls open every term — organising committees, design, editorial, programming and chapter teams. No experience needed, just curiosity.
